description: Source code for managing MIME type aliases, including data structures and functions for reading alias data from a file, storing, and freeing alias entries.

classes.name: XdgAlias
classes.description: Data structure representing an alias and its associated MIME type.

classes.name: XdgAliasList
classes.description: Data structure for a list of MIME type aliases.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_alias_list_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new XdgAliasList.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_alias_list_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an XdgAliasList and its entries.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_alias_read_from_file
methods.description: Reads alias data from a specified file and populates an XdgAliasList.
